request.name: OCIO
request.audience: Portfolio managers when deciding how much to invest on behalf of clients in an investment
request.description:
Mandate Target Manager — Functional Description
Nov 23, 2026 · @Bill McMahon
The Mandate Target Manager is a working prototype that lets a fund-of-funds and directs manager set allocation targets for each client and mandate sleeve, track deployment pace against those targets, test compliance rules against original commitments, and allocate new deals across sleeves using a sharing ratio constrained by compliance. Everything runs in one browser page on example data; nothing is connected to a live system yet.
Purpose and core concepts
The app answers four questions for each client and mandate sleeve: what we want the portfolio to look like, how fast we are getting there, whether we are inside our compliance limits, and how much of a new deal each sleeve should take.
Who it is for: portfolio managers and allocation committees setting targets and approving allocations, investment operations maintaining targets and the security master, and compliance reviewing rule results.
Concept
What it means in the app
Client
The macro level: an investor with its own program size, deployment pace and targets that apply across all of its sleeves
Mandate sleeve
A portfolio under a client with its own program size, start and end dates, annual deployment target, targets and compliance rules
Hierarchy
One of three ways to classify an investment: Category › Asset Class › Strategy › Sub-Strategy; Region › Asset Class; Category › Structure Type › Structure Detail. Values and parent–child links come from the seven uploaded list files
Measure
Every target can be set in dollars ($), number of investments (#) and percent (%)
Band
Each measure has a min, a target and a max. Any combination can be set, at any level
% basis
Per client or sleeve: a % target is a share of the total program, or a share of the level above
Original commitment
One investment booked to a sleeve, carrying its target tags and its security-master (compliance) attributes
Compliance rule
A rule from the compliance workbook, attached to a sleeve with its own limit and Hard or Soft severity
Sharing ratio
A sleeve's share of a new deal, from its remaining profile allocation spread over the years left in its investment period
Targets can be set at any level, and child levels do not have to add up to the parent; the app shows the gap rather than enforcing it.
App structure and navigation
The page has three top-level views, a left rail of clients and sleeves, and, in the main view, a header ribbon and six tabs for the selected client or sleeve.
Header bar
• Assign targets — the main working view for one client or sleeve (tabs below).
• Overview — coverage, pacing and compliance across every client and sleeve.
• Pipeline — the deal pipeline with the allocation grid underneath.
• Undo (also Ctrl+Z), Copy CSV (every target, with min / target / max per measure) and Reset example (restores the example data).
Left rail (clients and mandates)
• Each client is listed with its sleeves indented underneath. Selecting one opens it in Assign targets.
• Each row shows program size, investment count, the number of targets assigned, a red badge for compliance breaches, a pacing-velocity tag for the current year, and three small bars showing which hierarchies have any targets.
• + Add mandate sleeve opens a form: client, name, program $, investments, start date, annual deployment target and % basis.
Entity header and ribbon (Assign targets view)
• Breadcrumb, name, the % basis switch (Program or Parent level) and Copy targets from…, which copies targets from another client or sleeve by hierarchy, with a choice to keep, replace or clear existing targets first.
• The ribbon shows program size and % committed, investments made against target, current-year deployment against the annual target, pacing velocity, since-inception velocity, compliance status and the last-12-month run-rate. The compliance cell opens the Compliance tab.
Tabs: Strategy, Region and Structure (one per hierarchy), then Pacing, Commitments and Compliance. Each tab carries a count: targets per hierarchy, commitments, or breaches.
Persistence: all edits are saved in the viewer's own browser and survive a reload, but are not shared with other people or devices. Every change can be undone.
Target tabs: Strategy, Region, Structure
Each hierarchy tab is an editable tree grid where targets are entered at any level and every row shows committed amounts against its band. The Total program row at the top holds the program's own $ and # band.
Column
What it shows and does
Level name
Indented tree with expand / collapse, a level tag (CAT, AC, STRAT, SUB, RGN, TYPE, DETAIL) and an "N below" pill on collapsed rows that hold targets further down. Rows with a target carry an accent stripe
$ Dollars
Min, target and max inputs. Bare numbers are millions; K and B suffixes work. Empty cells show the value implied by the % band in grey (≈)
# Investments
Min, target and max number of investments
% Percent
Min, target and max as a share of the program or of the level above, per the % basis. Disabled on the Total program row
Band bar (under each measure)
Shaded min–max range, a tick at the target and a fill for committed commitments. Green = in range or at target, amber = below min, red = above max or over target, blue = building toward a target with no band. Hover gives the exact status
Children Σ
Compares the next level's targets with this row: dollars as a coverage % and investments as n / N. Green = adds up, amber = under, red = over
Client target / Σ Sleeves
On a sleeve: the client's macro target for the same level. On a client: the total of all sleeves' dollar targets and how many sleeves set one
Clear (×)
Clears every target on the row
Actual % basis: the % band bar measures commitments at the level as a share of all committed commitments (or of the level above). Only a % band entered by the user is judged; implied % values stay as hints.
Editing: Tab moves across min / target / max, Enter or the arrow keys move down a r

summary: Mandate Target Manager (OCIO) is an institutional multi-sleeve allocation and portfolio construction surface anchored on FUND entities (representing both macro Client master accounts and Mandate Sleeves). It enables portfolio managers and allocation committees to set tri-measure allocation target bands ($ / # / %) across three orthogonal hierarchies (Strategy, Region, Structure), track pacing velocity against annual commitment targets, evaluate pre-trade and standing compliance limits via the compliance engine, and calculate dynamic deal-sharing ratios across sleeves.
uxNotes: Replaced generic modal shadows with 1px border dialogs matching institutional styling.
Ensured all numeric columns ($ Dollars, # Investments, % Share, Velocity, Run Rate) use tabular numerals and right text alignment.
Replaced colored emoji status indicators with standardized status pills (.cpill, .pill) adhering to the house design tokens.
Added direct SVG labels to pacing bar charts, removing floating external tooltips.
Integrated unified keyboard navigation (Tab between Min/Target/Max, Enter to commit and advance down tree rows).

standards.note: Every metric derived from master attributes (Program Size, Base Currency, Investment Period End, Holding commitments) is wrapped in InspectValue with attrBind, enabling right-click lineage inspection.
standards.title: Right-click opens the value’s sources

standards.note: Min, Target, and Max cells for $, #, and % across Strategy, Region, and Structure grids support in-place editing, committing changes through the golden-record manual override mutation.
standards.title: Editable values edit in place

standards.note: All 6 tabs call host.usePublishTabs to broadcast current sleeve totals, active targets, pacing velocity, and compliance status to the tapestr.ai assistant.
standards.title: Every tab is published to the assistant

standards.note: Publishes the currently selected client or sleeve FUND entity via usePublishViewContext(entityViewFocus(activeFund)).
standards.title: The page tells the assistant what record is open

standards.note: All queries bind host.asOfDate and host.knowledgeDate, recalculating target adherence and pacing run-rates as of historical periods.
standards.title: As Of and Knowledge dates apply

standards.note: Target matrices and pacing configurations are stored as formal FUND attributes (FUND_TARGET_MATRIX, FUND_ANNUAL_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET, FUND_TARGET_PERCENT_BASIS), never ad-hoc SQL tables.
standards.title: Fields are attributes, not new columns

standards.note: No hardcoded client or mandate identifiers. Hierarchy taxonomy trees and rules are driven dynamically by reference data lists and compliance scope assignments.
standards.title: No code names a client, rule or entity by its code

standards.note: Compliance evaluation and capacity checks call evaluate_compliance_rule, evaluate_compliance_proforma, and investment_capacity directly; no client-side math replication.
standards.title: One interpreter per concept

standards.note: Seeded attributes (FUND_TARGET_MATRIX, FUND_ANNUAL_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET, FUND_TARGET_PERCENT_BASIS, FUND_TARGET_INVESTMENT_COUNT) are added via supabase/seed files.
standards.title: Migrations change schema; records go in seed

standards.note: Surface is located under surfaces/ocio-target-manager/ and strictly imports from React, @tapestrai/surface-sdk, and @tapestrai/ui.
standards.title: A client surface uses only the surface SDK

standards.note: Automated sharing ratios and target recommendations are proposed by the agentic workflow and require explicit PM confirmation before booking.
standards.title: An agent proposes, a person approves, a fixed step applies

standards.note: Standardized loading spinners, empty states with clear explanatory text, and actionable error panels are implemented across all hierarchy trees and charts.
standards.title: Loading, empty and error states

standards.note: Strict compliance with house styling: monospace tabular numerals, right-aligned monetary values, single accent (#6aa5e0), 1px solid low-contrast borders, no drop shadows.
standards.title: House design system

standards.note: Header breadcrumb links Client -> Sleeve -> Golden Record using surface-links.ts.
standards.title: Crumbs and record links

workflows.name: Pipeline Deal Allocation & Sharing Ratio Execution

steps.title: Calculate Optimal Sharing Ratios
steps.detail: Agent inspects each eligible sleeve's remaining investment period, undrawn commitment budget, annual pacing shortfall, and category target gaps, querying compliance capacity.

steps.title: Portfolio Manager Review & Overrides
steps.detail: PM inspects proposed pro-rata allocation matrix in the Pipeline view, adjusts dollar allocations or toggles sleeves, and verifies that no hard compliance breaches are introduced.

steps.title: Stage Deal Funding Plan
steps.detail: Writes approved allocation shares into DEAL_FUNDING_PLAN and creates draft syndicate order records for investment operations.

workflows.outcome: Allocations calculated, compliance verified across all target sleeves, and funding proposals staged for IC review
workflows.trigger: Portfolio manager initiates deal allocation from Pipeline view

buildSteps.title: Seed Attributes in Catalog
buildSteps.detail: Create new attributes FUND_TARGET_INVESTMENT_COUNT, FUND_ANNUAL_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET, FUND_TARGET_PERCENT_BASIS, and FUND_TARGET_MATRIX on the FUND domain.

buildSteps.title: Implement SDK Surface Component
buildSteps.detail: Create the client surface package under surfaces/ocio-target-manager/ using React and @tapestrai/surface-sdk with full tree-grid interactions, inline editing, and compliance integration.

buildSteps.title: Register Surface in App Registry
buildSteps.detail: Register 'ocio-target-manager' in apps/web/lib/surface-registry.ts and map it to the FUND domain.

capabilities.title: Compliance Rule Evaluation
capabilities.detail: Runs mandate concentration rules and guidelines directly via the single compliance interpreter.

capabilities.title: Pre-Trade Proforma Compliance & Capacity
capabilities.detail: Scores prospective pipeline deal allocations across all sleeves simultaneously to verify sharing ratios do not violate sleeve concentration limits.

capabilities.title: Bi-Temporal Target Matrix Persistence
capabilities.detail: Persists sleeve target matrix updates with effective validFrom/validTo dates and audit trail.

capabilities.title: Copy Targets Across Sleeves
capabilities.detail: Copies hierarchy target configuration from a client or peer sleeve with mode options: replace, append, or merge.

newAttributes.name: Target Investment Count
newAttributes.reason: Needed to store the macro investment count target (#) for the client or mandate sleeve.

newAttributes.name: Annual Deployment Target
newAttributes.reason: Stores the annual commitment pace dollar amount for pacing velocity calculations.

newAttributes.name: Target Percent Basis
newAttributes.reason: Configures whether percentage targets are evaluated against the program size or the immediate parent node in the hierarchy tree.

newAttributes.name: Target Allocation Matrix
newAttributes.reason: Stores the multi-lens target bands ($/ # / % min, target, max) entered by portfolio managers.

openQuestions: Should changes to FUND_TARGET_MATRIX be saved immediately on input blur or staged in a local draft batch requiring an explicit 'Commit Targets' action?
Confirm whether Deal Sharing Ratios should be written directly to DEAL_FUNDING_PLAN or submitted through an IC memo point review process first.
relationships: FUND_PARENT: Links mandate sleeves to parent client FUND records
COMMITMENT_FUND: Reaches all underlying commitments booked to a mandate sleeve
DEAL_FUNDING_PLAN: Connects pipeline deals and prospective tranches to the mandate sleeves
